extension.summary: Find duplicate movies and orphan video files in source paths
extension.description:
Two scans for cleaning up a Kodi video library.
1. Find duplicate movies: matched by IMDB/TMDB id, falling back to title + year. For each copy you can see the path, size and video stream, then delete unwanted files (and their library entry).
2. Find orphan video files: walks every configured video source and flags video files that are not present in the movie, episode or music-video library. You can scan the parent folder into the library or delete the file from disk.
